title: Cross-contract reentrancy in NFTMinter.mint() -- price updated after external calls
severity_rationale: Downgraded from H-02. Price IS updated before ERC1155 callback on line 139 (before _mint on line 142). The dispatch-path reentrancy requires non-standard tokens or malicious dispatcher. CEI violation is real but exploitation requires external conditions.
description: mint() follows: read price -> transferFrom -> dispatch (external) -> update price -> _mint (ERC1155 callback). Attacker can reenter during dispatch or ERC1155 callback to mint at stale price before growthBasisPoints increase.
impact: Attacker mints multiple NFTs at the old (lower) price, bypassing the price growth mechanism. Direct value extraction.
recommendation: Add ReentrancyGuard nonReentrant modifier to mint(), or apply checks-effects-interactions pattern
root_cause: State update after external calls, no reentrancy guard
